pack.name: Vampire Kingdom
pack.blurb: The Vampires: Zombies that pay Life Points for what they want. They send cards from the other side's Deck to the Graveyard, take over monsters they destroy in battle, and Vampire Kingdom destroys a card every time the other Deck loses one.

deck.name: Vampire Kingdom
deck.blurb: Vampire Takeover opens the Kingdom straight from the Deck. Shadow Vampire and Duke bring more Vampires with them, Fraulein pays Life Points to win any battle, and what your Vampires destroy comes back on your side.

lines: They say a graduate still walks the island at night, looking for one more duel.
They are right. And he has not been hungry for duels alone.
npc.intro: Class is in session. Mind your neck.
